newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Bio arthritis trials positive.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Bio arthritis trials positive.

text.p: Advanced Biotherapy Concepts Inc said Tuesday that patients suffering from severe rheumatoid arthritis showed improvement during clinical trials using AGT-1, a combination of antibody preparations.
Russian investigators working with Advanced Biotherapy scientists completed clinical trials on 20 adult rheumatoid arthritis patients using AGT-1, the company said.
AGT-1 removes or neutralizes soluble components of the immune system that are largely responsible for regulating the immune response and inflammation, the company said.
During certain autoimmune diseases, such as rheumatoid arthritis, these components are overproduced by the human body, disturbing the immune system and leading to disease.

These studies represent the first human clinical trials demonstrating that, in addition to alpha interferon and tumor necrosis factor, the gamma interferon component is a major factor in the development of autoimmune disease, the company said.
